message.reasoning:
I've got $122 in cash and my reds are well-developed, so there's no point building further. Unmortagging my blockers would drain resources I'd rather keep as a cushion, so I'll just end my turn and let St James, Tennessee, and Short Line stay mortgaged as they are. Wait, I need to reconsider the orange properties—St James and Tennessee are mine but mortgaged, and if Gemini owns New York and Atlantic, then the full orange set would be St James, Tennessee, and New York.

Since I don't have the monopoly, keeping them mortgaged as blockers makes sense. With $122 as my cushion, I'm ready to end my turn.
